title: Verify My Bookings page lists all existing bookings with complete details after successful login
preconditions: User is logged out (or the test begins from the login page)
Valid demo credentials available: email 'manish123@gmail.com', password 'Manish9@@'
At least one booking already exists in the system tied to the demo account (pre-existing seed data or bookings created in prior runs)
Browser: Chromium (project default), viewport 1366x768, OS Windows/macOS as available

testSteps.action: Navigate to https://eventhub.rahulshettyacademy.com/ and wait for the login form to be visible
testSteps.testData: URL: https://eventhub.rahulshettyacademy.com/

testSteps.action: Enter the demo email into the user email input
testSteps.testData: Email: manish123@gmail.com — Locator: getByPlaceholder('you@email.com')

testSteps.action: Enter the demo password into the password input
testSteps.testData: Password: Manish9@@ — Locator: getByPlaceholder('••••••')

testSteps.action: Click the 'Sign In' button and wait for the post-login app shell to render (network idle)
testSteps.testData: Locator: getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' })

testSteps.action: Click the 'My Bookings' tab in the top navigation
testSteps.testData: Locator: '#nav-bookings, a[href="/bookings"]', fallback getByRole('link', { name: /my bookings/i })

testSteps.action: Wait for the My Bookings listing view to load (network idle) and observe the rendered booking cards/rows
testSteps.testData: Locator for cards: '.booking-card, .booking-item, [data-testid="booking-card"], .card:has(.status), .card:has-text("Confirmed"), .card:has-text("Cancelled")'

testSteps.action: Verify the page heading reads 'My Bookings'
testSteps.testData: Locator: getByRole('heading', { name: /my bookings/i })

testSteps.action: Verify at least one booking card/row is visible and inspect the fields on the first booking (event name, date, venue, seats, price, status)
testSteps.testData: Locators scoped to first card: firstBookingEventName -> '.event-name, .card-title, h3, h4'; firstBookingDate -> '.event-date, .booking-date, time, date regex'; firstBookingVenue -> '.event-venue, .venue, .location'; firstBookingSeats -> '.seats, .booking-seats'; firstBookingPrice -> '.price, .total-price, currency regex'; firstBookingStatus -> '.status, .badge, .booking-status'

testSteps.action: Verify the URL contains '/bookings' (or the My Bookings route is active) and the 'My Bookings' nav item is the active/selected tab
testSteps.testData: n/a

testSteps.action: Verify at least one booking card displays a 'Confirmed' status badge
testSteps.testData: Locator: '.status, .badge, .booking-status' filtered by hasText /confirmed/i — assert count >= 1

expectedResult: The My Bookings page renders successfully after login. The page heading reads 'My Bookings'. At least one booking card is visible with complete details (event name, formatted date, venue, seat count, price, status badge). At least one 'Confirmed' status badge is present. The 'My Bookings' nav tab is the active navigation item and the URL reflects the My Bookings route (/bookings).

title: Verify successful cancellation of an existing Confirmed booking from the My Bookings page (happy path with confirmation modal)
preconditions: User is already authenticated as 'manish123@gmail.com' (login completed in TC-BOOK-001 or equivalent)
User is on the My Bookings listing page
At least one Confirmed booking exists for the demo account (so a Cancel action is available)

testSteps.action: Confirm the user is on the My Bookings page and the booking list is rendered
testSteps.testData: Locator: getByRole('heading', { name: /my bookings/i })

testSteps.action: Capture the event name and status of the first booking card BEFORE cancellation for later comparison
testSteps.testData: Locators: firstBookingCard -> '.booking-card, .booking-item, .card:has(.status)'; firstBookingEventName -> '.event-name, .card-title, h3, h4'; firstBookingStatus -> '.status, .badge, .booking-status'

testSteps.action: Click the 'Cancel' (or 'Cancel Booking') button on the first booking card
testSteps.testData: Locator scoped to first card: getByRole('button', { name: /^cancel( booking)?$/i })

testSteps.action: Wait for the cancellation confirmation modal/dialog to appear
testSteps.testData: Locator: '.modal.show, [role="dialog"]:visible, [data-testid="cancel-confirm-modal"]'

testSteps.action: Verify the modal displays confirmation copy and exposes 'Keep Booking' / 'Close' AND 'Confirm Cancel' / 'Yes, Cancel' actions
testSteps.testData: Locators: modalKeepBookingButton -> getByRole('button', { name: /keep booking|close|cancel$/i }); modalConfirmCancelButton -> getByRole('button', { name: /confirm cancel|yes,? cancel|confirm/i })

testSteps.action: Click 'Confirm Cancel' (or 'Yes, Cancel') inside the modal
testSteps.testData: Locator: modalConfirmCancelButton -> getByRole('button', { name: /confirm cancel|yes,? cancel|confirm/i })

testSteps.action: Wait for the modal to close and for the cancellation success toast/inline message to appear
testSteps.testData: Locator: '.toast, .alert-success, [role="status"], [data-testid="toast-success"]' filtered by hasText /cancel/i

testSteps.action: Verify the same booking card now displays a 'Cancelled' (or 'Canceled') status badge instead of 'Confirmed'
testSteps.testData: Locator: page.locator('.status, .badge, .booking-status').filter({ hasText: /cancelled|canceled/i }) — assert count increased by 1

testSteps.action: Verify the previously captured event name no longer appears as a 'Confirmed' booking, or that its status badge text has changed
testSteps.testData: Compare firstBookingStatus before/after; expected text contains /cancelled|canceled/i

testSteps.action: Click the 'Keep Booking' button on a DIFFERENT booking card (if available) to verify the modal's secondary action keeps the booking unchanged
testSteps.testData: Locator: modalKeepBookingButton -> getByRole('button', { name: /keep booking|close|cancel$/i }) — modal should close without status change

expectedResult: Clicking 'Cancel' on a Confirmed booking opens a confirmation modal with both 'Keep Booking'/'Close' and 'Confirm Cancel'/'Yes, Cancel' actions. Confirming via 'Confirm Cancel' closes the modal, surfaces a success toast confirming the cancellation, and updates the same booking card's status badge from 'Confirmed' to 'Cancelled'. Clicking 'Keep Booking' on a different card closes the modal without altering that booking's status, proving the secondary action is a no-op.
